bibl.title: Embedded Song and Poetic Authority in Pindar and Bacchylides.
bibl.seg: Sarah J. Harden, Embedded Song and Poetic Authority in Pindar and Bacchylides.

Egbert J. Bakker (ed.), Authorship and Greek Song: Authority, Authenticity, and Performance = Studies in Archaic and Classical Greek Song. 3 = Mnemosyne. Supplements. 402 (Leiden - Boston, 2017) pp. 139-160.
bibl.note: Shows that interaction between the embedded song (both in terms of content and performer) in Pindar, Nemean 5 and Bacchylides 13 and the frame narrative in these two epinician poems is a major means by which both poets create a sense of their own authority.
